name: National Fellowship for Scheduled Caste Students (NFSC)
provider: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment via NSFDC

rules.quote: financial assistance to students belonging to SC category to pursue higher studies leading to M.Phil/Ph.D
who have qualified in the UGC NET / Joint CSIR UGC NET exam
to undertake advanced studies and research leading to M.Phil/Ph.D Degrees

amount.text: 2,000 fellowships a year (1,500 humanities/social science, 500 science); rates per guideline PDF
amount.quote: The scheme provides for 2000 new Fellowships (1500 Junior Research Fellows for Humanities/ Social Sciences and 500 Junior Research Fellows for Science stream) per year

deadline.text: Selection through UGC NET / CSIR NET cycles run by NTA
deadline.quote: The SC candidates to be awarded with NFSC are selected by National Testing Agency (NTA) through UGC NET and Joint CSIR UGC NET exams.
